caption: The drawing depicts a long wooden bench with a backrest and armrests, designed in a traditional style. The bench is dark brown, almost black in color, with gold decorative patterns painted on the upper rail of the backrest and the corners of the seat. The backrest consists of multiple evenly spaced vertical spindles that are turned and ornately shaped. The armrests curve outward smoothly from the backrest, ending in rounded tips. The legs and stretchers of the bench are also turned and have a matching dark brown color with subtle gold accents. The entire bench is shown at a slight angle, giving a clear view of its depth and structure, and it is centered within a plain cream-colored background, bordered by a simple rectangular outline.
title: Settee
